{{Quote|I'm Major Tyrus, commander of the Second Battalion.|Tyrus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tyrus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], commanding the [[Fifth Infantry]]'s [[Second Battalion (Fifth Infantry)|Second Battalion]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Tyrus oversaw his unit's combat with the [[Balmorran resistance]]; he dispatched [[Besh Company]] to plant viruses in the mainframe of the [[Okara Droid Factory]], and was forced to recruit outside help after the company was nearly wiped out.<ref name="TOR" />
